title: Felix and the Verdict
author: Yara Kavanagh
blurb: Marguerite Pemberton, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
